applications.name: AIPA Agent Harness
applications.title: AIPA Agent Harness
applications.description: Agent runtime derived from OpenBB agent-rita. Handles AskAgent, stages fdc3.data.file, runs a tool loop with generic FDC3 Desktop Agent tools (including fdc3_discover_*), and streams fdc3.ai.agentDelta / agentAnswer. LLM via /api/query.

AskAgent.purpose: Start an AI agent session that plans and calls FDC3 tools for a natural-language query; result is a PrivateChannel of fdc3.ai deltas/answers.
